experiment.name: VERCEL_SANDBOX_NESTED_OCI_RUNTIME
experiment.cause: the Vercel project invoked vercel-build twice and the bounded probe lacked an already-finished marker
experiment.interpretation: This falsifies the direct dnf-provisioned Podman/Buildah route in the observed Vercel Sandbox image. It does not establish that OCI execution is impossible on Vercel or that all nested-container mechanisms fail.
